title: NotebookLM for Windows
subtitle: Native desktop wrapper · 2,000+ downloads
description: Power users of NotebookLM lose context every time they leave the browser. I shipped an Electron-based desktop wrapper with session persistence, system-level shortcuts, and native notifications for long-running audio generation tasks. The product converts a research-heavy web app into a persistent, OS-integrated workspace. Crossed 2,000 downloads organically.
